messages:
kyle: Heads up - eu-west3 cohort-9 showing a sustained local NVMe IOPS spike (~3x baseline), GPU attaches stalling (~30% failed binds). Looks correlated with scrub/fstrim overlap.
maria: Which cohort/nodes? any logs?
kyle: scratchpool-cohort-9. Example from gn-eu3-142: `nvme0 qdepth 256 -> 1024 qfull`. Kernel shows blk_mq qdepth overflow + janitor reporting high iops. snippet: ```May 12 09:12:04 gn-eu3-142 kernel: blk_mq: I/O error, qdepth overflow
May 12 09:12:05 gn-eu3-142 janitor[2345]: scrub: read-errors=0, iops=62000, backlog=12```
raj: Can we throttle janitor/scrub cadence for cohort-9? Defer scrubs if wear is low. Cheaper than replacing nodes during transient spikes.
nana: Proposal: 1) pause scrub window for cohort-9 for 30m, 2) reroute new GPU attaches to eu-west3-dedicated-1 for 20m, 3) only trigger proactive replacement if SMART crosses threshold. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
infra-bot: ALERT: nvme_iops_spike detected on scratchpool-cohort-9 (nodes: gn-eu3-138..gn-eu3-144). Autoscaler paused 4 attaches in last 10m.
ops-sre: +1 to throttle. Command to set janitor ratecap: ```curl -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/v1/janitor/ratecap -d '{"cohort":"cohort-9","iops_cap":30000,"duration":"30m"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'```
kyle: Applying ratecap and tagging hot nodes to avoid new preemptible attaches: `tag node gn-eu3-142 nvme:hot=true`. Also adding a temporary attach route to dedicated pool.
maria: After ratecap, attach success improved from 68% -> 92% in 5m. Good signal.
raj: Cost note: shifting attaches to dedicated pool adds marginal unit cost ~0.8c/op equivalent during window (~+$1.2k/day if prolonged). We should watch and switch back ASAP.
nana: I'll run a quick eval to ensure deferring scrubs doesn't cause regressions. If SMART trends upward we flip to retirement.
ops-sre: Logging decision and creating a postmortem stub in #postmortems in case wear leads to later impact. For now avoid node replacements. :clipboard:
kyle: TL;DR: throttle janitor for 30m, reroute new attaches to dedicated pool, monitor SMART & attach SLOs. I'll update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
